question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Tax Relief for Fraud Victims Act (H R 9500)
bill_title: Tax Relief for Fraud Victims Act
plain_language: This bill widens the tax deduction for theft and fraud losses, including losses that are not from a declared disaster, and it eases related refund and retirement-plan rules. A two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — IRS Whistleblower Program Improvement Act (H R 7959)
plain_language: This bill modifies provisions of the Internal Revenue Code relating to whistleblower awards and protections. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Agreeing to the Resolution — Expressing support for tax policies that support working families (H RES 1156)
bill_title: Expressing support for tax policies that support working families.
plain_language: This resolution expresses support for tax policies that support working families and recognizes the tax relief enacted as part of the 2025 reconciliation act. A Yea agrees to the resolution; a Nay opposes it.
